gen-dafont-redux-gf-lexend: Redux spaces its letters wide and gives each curve a visible run-in. Its strokes swell and thin in tiny steps, so it earns its place big and brief, while Lexend keeps a flat, pressure-free line in its sans-serif lowercase.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca draws a plain, unshaded line, with terminals that stop short of curling. Redux brings a faint engraved-brass contrast to the headings, and the two sit together without any thick-thin flicker.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-liter: Redux leads with slightly lighter diagonals and a wide, spaced-out stance. Liter follows with a sans-serif lowercase that stands tall and has no stroke contrast, which is the clearest difference between them.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-mada: Wide, tall and open, with the faint heft shifts of a carved inscription up in the heading. Mada's sans-serif lowercase stands high and quiet underneath.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-martel-sans: Redux carries a hint of wedge-shaped pen pressure in every curve, spaced wide across each line. And Martel Sans answers in a plain sans with generous openings and a high mean line, with almost no stroke contrast.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-matangi: Soft modulation, like hand-drawn ink, runs through every wide-spaced curve of Redux, each with a big entrance stroke. Matangi is the hefty, twine-like plain sans with no contrast.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-maven-pro: Modern and measured, Redux sets thread-like weight differences beside wide spacing. But Maven Pro brings a neon-tube thickness in a sans-serif with a high-waisted lowercase and a welcoming open c.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-michroma: Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips in a sans. Redux adds a modest dip in its thin strokes, so the two feel spacious without matching.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-miriam-libre: Redux makes its horizontals slightly slimmer than its verticals and spaces everything wide. And Miriam Libre holds a plain sans line like cut ribbon, with a tall lowercase of cast-iron stature.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads with a very large lowercase eye, letters hung like clothespins on a line. Mochiy Pop One's sans form is bent from one length of tubing, while Redux tugs a little with heavier verticals and lighter horizontals.
